say:1:1010401001:0.text:
You look tired, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I know you've been working hard.
Tell me, have you made any new discoveries?
say:1:1010401001:0.male:
You look tired, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I know you've been working hard.
Tell me, have you made any new discoveries?
say:1:1010401001:0.female:
You look tired, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I know you've been working hard.
Tell me, have you made any new discoveries?

say:3:1010401002:0.text: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:3:1010401002:0.source_cn: 原来弗朗茨才是纵火的幕后主使……
say:3:1010401002:0.male: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:3:1010401002:0.female: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...

say:4:1010401003:0.text: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:4:1010401003:0.source_cn: 他躲在暗处，凭借丰厚的财力操控着一群木偶。
say:4:1010401003:0.male: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:4:1010401003:0.female: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.

say:6:1010401013:0.text: That's exactly what I was afraid of.

say:7:1010401014:0.text: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.
say:7:1010401014:0.male: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.
say:7:1010401014:0.female: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.

say:8:1010401015:0.text: Even if we bring witnesses to testify against him, all he has to do is feign ignorance and render our accusations meaningless.
say:8:1010401015:0.source_cn: 就算我们压着证人去找他对质，只要他矢口否认，说自己毫不...

say:9:1010401016:0.text: We need more conclusive proof, something that even he won't be able to deny.
say:9:1010401016:0.source_cn: 必须抓住更直观的证据，让他无话可说。

say:10:1010401017:0.text: Before that, let me bring Miss Mirael here first. Now that we know she's not the culprit, she shouldn't be locked up.
say:10:1010401017:0.source_cn: 在此之前，我先带米瑞尔女士过来。\n她洗清了嫌疑 ，理...

say:11:1010401018:0.text: She got blamed for this. She deserves to know the truth.
say:11:1010401018:0.source_cn: 她为此蒙冤，也有权了解真相。

narration:14:1010401019:0.text: After a while, a guard appears with Mirael.
narration:14:1010401019:0.source_cn: 等待一段时间后，卫兵带米瑞尔过来了

say:21:1010401022:0.text: Umm... I know you don't want to see me right now, Miss Mirael.
say:21:1010401022:0.source_cn: 那个……米瑞尔小姐，我知道，你肯定不想见到我。

say:22:1010401023:0.text: But I would like to apologize for unjustly accusing you earlier. You see, all of this is...
say:22:1010401023:0.source_cn: 很抱歉之前冤枉了你，关于这一切，我想向你——

say:24:1010401025:0.text: If anything, I should thank you.
say:24:1010401025:0.source_cn: 说不定，反而是我该谢谢你的纠缠呢。

say:25:1010401026:0.text: If it wasn't for you, he wouldn't be running around for my sake.
say:25:1010401026:0.male: If it wasn't for you, he wouldn't be running around for my sake.
say:25:1010401026:0.female: If it wasn't for you, she wouldn't be running around for my sake.

say:30:1010401030:0.text: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.
say:30:1010401030:0.source_cn: 你一定有问题想问我，我们换个地方聊，就选在西北边的小花...
say:30:1010401030:0.male: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.
say:30:1010401030:0.female: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.

say:32:1010401032:0.text: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...
say:32:1010401032:0.source_cn: 这是，独属于我们二人的……
say:32:1010401032:0.male: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...
say:32:1010401032:0.female: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...

say:36:1010401034:0.source_cn: 约、约会？她刚刚说了……约会？

say:40:1010401036:0.text: What?! Don't ask something silly like that, Chippy!
say:40:1010401036:0.source_cn: 呀——！！！不要问这么愚蠢的问题啊！

say:44:1010401037:0.text:
Ahem... We should return to the Heroic Order, Valen.
You had something important to report, didn't you?
say:44:1010401037:0.source_cn: 咳……维、维伦，我们走吧，回骑士团。\n你刚刚不是有要...

say:47:1010401038:0.text: Hm? Not really... Hey! General! Why are you dragging me away?!
say:47:1010401038:0.source_cn: 啊？不是……喂！将军——你别拽我啊！

say:51:1010401039:0.text: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.
say:51:1010401039:0.source_cn: 哇哦……感觉要发生有意思的事情了。
say:51:1010401039:0.male: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.
say:51:1010401039:0.female: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.

say:52:1010401040:0.text: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!
say:52:1010401040:0.male: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!
say:52:1010401040:0.female: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!

say:54:1010401029:0.text: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.
say:54:1010401029:0.source_cn: 我知道，你嘴上说的和心里想的，总是不太一样。
say:54:1010401029:0.male: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.
say:54:1010401029:0.female: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.

say:55:1010401005:0.text: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.
say:55:1010401005:0.source_cn: 真抱歉啊……因为你是我最信任的人，所以总是麻烦你。
say:55:1010401005:0.male: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.
say:55:1010401005:0.female: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.

say:56:1010401006:0.text: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?
say:56:1010401006:0.source_cn: 等这些事情忙完，我请你去<style=highligh...
say:56:1010401006:0.male: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?
say:56:1010401006:0.female: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?

say:58:1010401007:0.text:
That's the most famous restaurant in town!
I've never seen you spend that kind of money, General! You gotta invite me too!
say:58:1010401007:0.source_cn: 那可是镇上最有名的餐厅！\n将军，难得见您破费，请客的...

say:59:1010401008:0.text: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?
say:59:1010401008:0.source_cn: 我可是奉您的命令一直保护着<style=stress>...
say:59:1010401008:0.male: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?
say:59:1010401008:0.female: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?

say:60:1010401009:0.text: Yes, yes, just give it a rest already.

say:62:1010401010:0.text: Now then, back to official business.

say:64:1010401011:0.text: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:64:1010401011:0.source_cn: 原来弗朗茨才是纵火的幕后主使……
say:64:1010401011:0.male: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:64:1010401011:0.female: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...

say:65:1010401012:0.text: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:65:1010401012:0.source_cn: 他躲在暗处，凭借丰厚的财力操控着一群木偶。
say:65:1010401012:0.male: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:65:1010401012:0.female: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.

say:0:1010402001:0.text: ...Should I go find Mirael right now?
say:0:1010402001:0.male: ...Should I go find Mirael right now?
say:0:1010402001:0.female: ...Should I go find Mirael right now?

say:2:1010403002:1.text: You look like you have hundreds of questions to ask me.
say:2:1010403002:1.source_cn: 看你的样子，一定有不少话想要问我。
say:2:1010403002:1.male: You look like you have hundreds of questions to ask me.
say:2:1010403002:1.female: You look like you have hundreds of questions to ask me.

say:3:1010403003:1.text: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.
say:3:1010403003:1.source_cn: 一个个问吧，我的心情还不错，说不定会回答你。
say:3:1010403003:1.male: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.
say:3:1010403003:1.female: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.

choice_prompt:4:1010403003.text: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.
choice_prompt:4:1010403003.source_cn: 一个个问吧，我的心情还不错，说不定会回答你。
choice_prompt:4:1010403003.male: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.
choice_prompt:4:1010403003.female: Just ask. I'm in a good mood. You might even get some answers this time.

say:5:1010403004:1.text: The ward... so even you're saying it's a ward.
say:5:1010403004:1.source_cn: 加护吗……竟然连你也这样称呼它。
say:5:1010403004:1.male: The ward... so even you're saying it's a ward.
say:5:1010403004:1.female: The ward... so even you're saying it's a ward.

say:6:1010403005:1.text: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.
say:6:1010403005:1.source_cn: 关于过去的一切，你好像全都忘了。
say:6:1010403005:1.male: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.
say:6:1010403005:1.female: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.

choice_prompt:7:1010403005.text: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.
choice_prompt:7:1010403005.source_cn: 关于过去的一切，你好像全都忘了。
choice_prompt:7:1010403005.male: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.
choice_prompt:7:1010403005.female: It seems you've completely forgotten about the past.

say:8:1010403006:1.text: From what I understand, this is no mere <style="highlight">ward</style>.
say:8:1010403006:1.male: From what I understand, this is no mere <style="highlight">ward</style>.
say:8:1010403006:1.female: From what I understand, this is no mere <style="highlight">ward</style>.

say:9:1010403007:1.text: I once promised <style="highlight">a person</style> long ago that no matter who asked, I would never divulge the truth about this.
say:9:1010403007:1.male: I once promised <style="highlight">a person</style> long ago that no matter who asked, I would never divulge the truth about this.
say:9:1010403007:1.female: I once promised <style="highlight">a person</style> long ago that no matter who asked, I would never divulge the truth about this.

say:10:1010403008:1.text: It's something very important. I can say no more.
say:10:1010403008:1.source_cn: 那是非常重要的事，我无法轻易告诉你。
say:10:1010403008:1.male: It's something very important. I can say no more.
say:10:1010403008:1.female: It's something very important. I can say no more.

say:11:1010403009:1.text: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.
say:11:1010403009:1.source_cn: 我只能说，有人企图破坏它。\n而我……很遗憾，我试过了...
say:11:1010403009:1.male: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.
say:11:1010403009:1.female: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.

choice_prompt:12:1010403009.text: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.
choice_prompt:12:1010403009.source_cn: 我只能说，有人企图破坏它。\n而我……很遗憾，我试过了，我无法阻止。
choice_prompt:12:1010403009.male: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.
choice_prompt:12:1010403009.female: All I can say is that someone is interfering with it. Sadly, I tried, but I couldn't stop it.

say:13:1010403010:1.text: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.
say:13:1010403010:1.source_cn: 我也不知道。对方行事谨慎，我没能抓住他们的把柄。
say:13:1010403010:1.male: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.
say:13:1010403010:1.female: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.

choice_prompt:14:1010403010.text: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.
choice_prompt:14:1010403010.source_cn: 我也不知道。对方行事谨慎，我没能抓住他们的把柄。
choice_prompt:14:1010403010.male: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.
choice_prompt:14:1010403010.female: I'm not sure. The culprits covered their tracks, and I couldn't find any clues.

say:15:1010403011:1.text: I can't answer that right now...
say:15:1010403011:1.source_cn: 关于这一点……我暂时不想回答你。
say:15:1010403011:1.male: I can't answer that right now...
say:15:1010403011:1.female: I can't answer that right now...

say:16:1010403012:1.text: You've asked enough questions. Now it's my turn.
say:16:1010403012:1.source_cn: 你问了好多问题呢，这次，换我发问了。
say:16:1010403012:1.male: You've asked enough questions. Now it's my turn.
say:16:1010403012:1.female: You've asked enough questions. Now it's my turn.

say:17:1010403013:1.text: What do you think about the location of our date?
say:17:1010403013:1.source_cn: 喜欢这次的约会地点吗？
say:17:1010403013:1.male: What do you think about the location of our date?
say:17:1010403013:1.female: What do you think about the location of our date?

choice_prompt:18:1010403013.text: What do you think about the location of our date?
choice_prompt:18:1010403013.source_cn: 喜欢这次的约会地点吗？
choice_prompt:18:1010403013.male: What do you think about the location of our date?
choice_prompt:18:1010403013.female: What do you think about the location of our date?

say:19:1010403014:1.text: Well, I'm rather fond of this spot.
say:19:1010403014:1.male: Well, I'm rather fond of this spot.
say:19:1010403014:1.female: Well, I'm rather fond of this spot.

say:20:1010403015:1.text: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.
say:20:1010403015:1.source_cn: 你看这里的花，虽是蓝色，但有个人曾说过，我很像它。
say:20:1010403015:1.male: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.
say:20:1010403015:1.female: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.

choice_prompt:21:1010403015.text: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.

choice_prompt:21:1010403015.male: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.
choice_prompt:21:1010403015.female: See these blue flowers? Someone once told me that I'm just like them.

say:23:1010403018:1.text: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.
say:23:1010403018:1.source_cn: 猜对了，我会给你一些奖赏。
say:23:1010403018:1.male: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.
say:23:1010403018:1.female: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.

choice_prompt:24:1010403018.text: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.
choice_prompt:24:1010403018.source_cn: 猜对了，我会给你一些奖赏。
choice_prompt:24:1010403018.male: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.
choice_prompt:24:1010403018.female: If you're right, I'll give you a prize.

say:25:1010403019:1.source_cn: 嗯……这个答案，到底是对还是不对呢。

say:26:1010403020:1.text: Don't look at me like that. I never said I would tell you if you were right or wrong.
say:26:1010403020:1.source_cn: 干嘛摆出那副表情？我可没说要告诉你正确答案哦。
say:26:1010403020:1.male: Don't look at me like that. I never said I would tell you if you were right or wrong.
say:26:1010403020:1.female: Don't look at me like that. I never said I would tell you if you were right or wrong.

say:27:1010403022:1.text: You'll know if you guessed right next time we meet.
say:27:1010403022:1.source_cn: 答案正确与否，在下次见面时，你会知道的。
say:27:1010403022:1.male: You'll know if you guessed right next time we meet.
say:27:1010403022:1.female: You'll know if you guessed right next time we meet.

say:28:1010403023:1.text: And trust me... There will be a next time.
say:28:1010403023:1.male: And trust me... There will be a next time.
say:28:1010403023:1.female: And trust me... There will be a next time.

say:32:1010403016:1.text: Back then, <style="highlight">this person</style> would sit here all day and gaze at the river.
say:32:1010403016:1.male: Back then, <style="highlight">this person</style> would sit here all day and gaze at the river.
say:32:1010403016:1.female: Back then, <style="highlight">this person</style> would sit here all day and gaze at the river.

choice:14:0:1.text: How do you know about me?
choice:14:0:1.male: How do you know about me?
choice:14:0:1.female: How do you know about me?

say:0:1010404001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Sorry to interrupt your date, but Lord Franz is at Holistone!
say:0:1010404001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Sorry to interrupt your date, but Lord Franz is at Holistone!
say:0:1010404001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Sorry to interrupt your date, but Lord Franz is at Holistone!

say:1:1010404002:0.text: He said he had something important to tell someone. Let's snoop.
say:1:1010404002:0.source_cn: 他想见一个人，说有要事告知，可能有什么阴谋，我们说不定...
say:1:1010404002:0.male: He said he had something important to tell someone. Let's snoop.
say:1:1010404002:0.female: He said he had something important to tell someone. Let's snoop.

say:0:1010404501:0.text: Lord Franz, Madam really can't see you.
say:0:1010404501:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨先生，夫人真的无法见您

say:2:1010405001:0.text: ...In any case, my lady is tending to important business. You may take your leave now, Lord Franz.
say:2:1010405001:0.source_cn: ……总之，夫人有事外出了，弗朗茨先生，请回吧。

say:3:1010405002:0.text: Wait! Wait! Tell me what you want. I'll give you anything. Just let me see <style="highlight">Lady Vala</style>!
say:3:1010405002:0.source_cn: 等等！你想要什么？我都可以给你！让我见见维拉夫人！

say:4:1010405003:0.text: Please excuse me. I have to leave to attend some other matters.
say:4:1010405003:0.source_cn: 抱歉，我还有事，先告退了。

say:8:1010405005:0.text: There are some things money can't buy.
say:8:1010405005:0.source_cn: 这世界上有不少东西，无法用金钱购买。

say:9:1010405006:0.text: It seems you're still having trouble understanding that, Lord Franz.
say:9:1010405006:0.source_cn: 看来，尊贵的弗朗茨先生并不懂得这个道理。

say:10:1010405007:0.text: You lot again? Such an unseemly group of people... Like diseased rats spreading their plague everywhere they go!
say:10:1010405007:0.source_cn: 又是你们……看看这一张张令人心烦的面孔。像是沾染了疫病...

say:11:1010405008:0.text: It seems like you're the one being treated like a pest. She wouldn't even see you.
say:11:1010405008:0.source_cn: 在那位夫人眼里，弗朗茨先生您怕是连老鼠都不如。

say:12:1010405009:0.source_cn: 住口！你们这群该死的老鼠！！来人啊！！！

say:13:1010405010:0.text: Scum like you have no business roaming around these civilized streets! My men will teach you not to leave whatever hole you came from!
say:13:1010405010:0.source_cn: 去！给我教教他们！老鼠就该乖乖活在下水道，不要在大街上...

say:1:1010409001:0.text: Lady Vala! It's been quite difficult to get a meeting with you, my lady.
say:1:1010409001:0.source_cn: 维拉夫人！啊……见你一面简直比登天还难。

say:3:1010409002:0.text: You've got some nerve, Lord Franz. Is this how you respond when someone has no time to meet with you? By picking quarrels at their doorstep?
say:3:1010409002:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨先生，您可真是好大的面子。我有事无暇见您，您便要...

say:4:1010409003:0.text: You misunderstand, my lady... These miscreants were the ones who started the fight, not I!
say:4:1010409003:0.source_cn: 冤枉啊夫人……不怪我惹是生非，是这些人胡搅蛮缠！

say:8:1010409004:0.text: My noble lady, your eyes are as clear and brilliant as the stars in the night sky. Surely, you can see through the lies this man is telling you!
say:8:1010409004:0.source_cn: 尊贵的夫人，您那双眼睛亮如晚星，我相信它们一定能穿透谎...

say:9:1010409005:0.text: I care little for your petty squabbles.
say:9:1010409005:0.source_cn: 你们的黑与白，是与非，我不关心。

say:10:1010409006:0.text: If you wish to continue this farce, I demand that you do it elsewhere. If even one of my flowers gets stepped on, you will all suffer my wrath.
say:10:1010409006:0.source_cn: 只是要动粗请去别处，不要践踏了我的花园。

say:13:1010409007:0.text: Please don't be upset, my lady. It breaks my heart to see a frown on a face as beautiful and flawless as yours.
say:13:1010409007:0.source_cn: 别这么严肃。夫人，您适合多笑一笑，总是绷着脸，着实浪费...

say:14:1010409008:0.text: I beg your pardon, sir. While you do not wear the armor of the Heroic Order... Am I right to presume that you are a member of the Solitaries?
say:14:1010409008:0.source_cn: 这位先生，虽然你没穿骑士团的铠甲，但是我想……你是“隐...

say:15:1010409009:0.text: Why is someone like you getting involved in petty disputes such as this?
say:15:1010409009:0.source_cn: 此间种种，不过乡土凡事之争，真的需要身为“隐士”的你插...

say:16:1010409010:0.text:
?!
What do you mean, my lady?

say:17:1010409011:0.text: Spying, secrets, gossip-mongering... The Solitaries are known to be masters of deception. The Heroic Order are the swords and shields of the nobility. How can one be unaware of those who serve them?
say:17:1010409011:0.source_cn: 谍信、秘闻、情报，流言……这些不是“隐士”的专属。骑士...

say:18:1010409012:0.text: ... Then it is I who have taken the liberty.

say:19:1010409013:0.text: There, now you sound much more like a Solitary.
say:19:1010409013:0.source_cn: 说得好，骑士先生，这才是“隐士”之风。

say:23:1010409014:0.text: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?
say:23:1010409014:0.source_cn: 主、主人……我怎么觉得，那位夫人明明是在跟维伦说话，眼...
say:23:1010409014:0.male: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?
say:23:1010409014:0.female: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?

say:26:1010409017:0.text: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...
say:26:1010409017:0.source_cn: 啊！她把视线挪开了……她的视线像箭尖般犀利……我的心脏...
say:26:1010409017:0.male: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...
say:26:1010409017:0.female: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...

say:29:1010409018:0.text: Now then, Lord Franz. What could be so urgent that you would disturb me like this?
say:29:1010409018:0.source_cn: 那么，弗朗茨先生，你这次找我有何贵干？

say:32:1010409019:0.text: My lady, I merely wish to extend an invitation to the <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style>.

say:33:1010409020:0.text: This year's harvest of the Gemvine was quite good. I will host a banquet in celebration. I would like to invite you to come.
say:33:1010409020:0.source_cn: 今年藤水晶大丰收，我想在庄园里举办宴会庆祝。您正好在圣...

say:35:1010409022:0.text:
Now, if that is all, I'd like to go get some rest.
I wish you all a pleasant day and safe travels.
say:35:1010409022:0.source_cn: 要是没有别的事，我先回去休息了。\n请各位慢走，不送。

narration:37:1010409023:0.text: Before she leaves, Lady Vala peers toward us with a mysterious look on her face.
narration:37:1010409023:0.source_cn: 临走前，维拉夫人向这边深深地望了一眼，意味不明

say:40:1010409025:0.text:
Why do you ask? Does the idea frighten you?
There are only two kinds of people who receive this kind of special treatment from the Heroic Order.
say:40:1010409025:0.source_cn: 怎么，你怕了？别怕啊。\n能被骑士团天天跟着，只有两种...

say:41:1010409026:0.text:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.
say:41:1010409026:0.male:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.
say:41:1010409026:0.female:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.

say:42:1010409027:0.text: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?
say:42:1010409027:0.male: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?
say:42:1010409027:0.female: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?

say:43:1010409028:0.text: With neither wealth nor title, what makes him any different from the rest of the common rabble?
say:43:1010409028:0.male: With neither wealth nor title, what makes him any different from the rest of the common rabble?
say:43:1010409028:0.female: With neither wealth nor title, what makes her any different from the rest of the common rabble?

say:46:1010409029:0.text:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!
say:46:1010409029:0.source_cn: 混蛋！知不知道你在和谁说话？！\n在你面前的可是那位大...
say:46:1010409029:0.male:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!
say:46:1010409029:0.female:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!

say:50:1010409032:0.text: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!
say:50:1010409032:0.source_cn: 我冷静不了！谁也不许说主人的坏话！！
say:50:1010409032:0.male: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!
say:50:1010409032:0.female: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!

say:53:1010409033:0.text: Summoning a couple of talking hairballs... All mages are mad, every last one of you.
say:53:1010409033:0.source_cn: 养着一群说话的耗子……果然魔法师都一样古怪。

say:56:1010409034:0.text: You seem to have some experience with mages, Lord Franz. Did you hear that a mage summoned fire elementals in Ryeham on the night of the fire?
say:56:1010409034:0.source_cn: 我听说金穗村发生火灾那晚，有魔法师召唤了火元素，这不就...

say:57:1010409035:0.text: Hmph! Insinuate all you want! It'll give you a chance to use that crusty brain of yours!
say:57:1010409035:0.source_cn: 尽管猜吧，尽管让你们生满铁锈的愚蠢脑袋运转吧！

say:58:1010409036:0.text: Don't overestimate yourselves. Making an enemy out of me is the worst thing you can do!
say:58:1010409036:0.source_cn: 不要以为自己掌握了胜机，和我作对，是你们步入失败的第一步！

narration:60:1010409037:0.text: Lord Franz arrogantly stomps away with his guards in tow.
narration:60:1010409037:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨带着护卫们嚣张地走远了

say:61:1010409038:0.text: That man's arrogance knows no bounds. He's been exposed, and yet he acts like nothing has happened...
say:61:1010409038:0.source_cn: 真是趾高气扬的人呐，明明已经被当面揭穿了……

say:62:1010409039:0.text:
What's this <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style> that he mentioned just now?
He's throwing a feast just to celebrate the harvest?

say:64:1010409040:0.text: Didn't hear about that. Lord Franz's manor is like a fortress, and he's never been one to have guests.
say:64:1010409040:0.source_cn: 没听说过。弗朗茨的府邸守卫比堡垒都森严，过去他从不邀请客人。

say:65:1010409041:0.text: So why would he suddenly want to throw a banquet now?
say:65:1010409041:0.source_cn: 那这次为什么要隆重地宴请宾客呢……

say:67:1010409042:0.text: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.
say:67:1010409042:0.male: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.
say:67:1010409042:0.female: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.

say:68:1010409043:0.text: If we attend the banquet, we might find some new clues.
say:68:1010409043:0.source_cn: 要是我们也能参加宴会，说不定会有所收获呢。

say:69:1010409046:0.text: Did you see that gold invitation he gave to the lady? Where can we get ourselves one?
say:69:1010409046:0.source_cn: 你们刚才看见拿给夫人那张金灿灿的邀请函了吗？我们去哪能...

say:70:1010409047:0.text: I think I may know someone who can do that for us.
say:70:1010409047:0.source_cn: 我猜，说不定有一个人可以。

say:72:1010409048:0.text:
Yes, that young man could be our ticket in.
We should go see him at the Mithril Consortium.
say:72:1010409048:0.source_cn: 没错，那位高贵的小少爷也许有办法。\n我们动身去秘银商...

say:74:1010409044:0.text: I envy the rich sometimes... They'll throw a feast for even the smallest of reasons.
say:74:1010409044:0.source_cn: 真羡慕有钱人呀……随便找个理由，就能举办宴会。

say:75:1010409045:0.text: But I have a feeling that if we attend the banquet, we might find some new clues.
say:75:1010409045:0.source_cn: 不过，我有种预感，要是我们也能参加宴会，说不定会有所收获呢。

choice:54:0:1.source_cn: 还有其他魔法师？请引荐

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 可能是我的外貌太出众

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 可能是猜到了我的真实身份

say:1:1010411001:0.text:
<style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you finished speaking to Miss Mirael?
I truly hope she can find it in her heart to forgive me...
say:1:1010411001:0.male:
<style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you finished speaking to Miss Mirael?
I truly hope she can find it in her heart to forgive me...
say:1:1010411001:0.female:
<style="stress"><player_name></style>, have you finished speaking to Miss Mirael?
I truly hope she can find it in her heart to forgive me...

say:3:1010411002:0.text:
Wonderful! We have a saying in our family. On the road, everyone is a customer.
The Mithril Consortium cannot afford to lose such a customer all because of my personal failures.
say:3:1010411002:0.source_cn: 那就好！家训有言，出门在外皆是客。\n我不能因为个人的...
say:3:1010411002:0.male:
Wonderful! We have a saying in our family. On the road, everyone is a customer.
The Mithril Consortium cannot afford to lose such a customer all because of my personal failures.
say:3:1010411002:0.female:
Wonderful! We have a saying in our family. On the road, everyone is a customer.
The Mithril Consortium cannot afford to lose such a customer all because of my personal failures.

say:6:1010411003:0.text: You only talk in business terms, don't you...? Anyway, did you happen to receive a gold invitation from Lord Franz recently?
say:6:1010411003:0.source_cn: 说来说去还是生意啊……对了，小少爷，你有没有收到弗朗茨...

say:8:1010411004:0.text: Do you mean this? It just arrived. I didn't get the chance to open it yet.
say:8:1010411004:0.source_cn: 你说这个？刚刚送来，我还没拆开看。

say:9:1010411005:0.text: Excellent! Thanks to our friend here, we have a chance of getting into the manor now!
say:9:1010411005:0.source_cn: 不愧是秘银商会的少爷！这下我们就有望混入庄园了。

say:10:1010411006:0.text: Although my orders are to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for the sake of our investigation, I will serve as your personal guard for a time.
say:10:1010411006:0.male: Although my orders are to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for the sake of our investigation, I will serve as your personal guard for a time.
say:10:1010411006:0.female: Although my orders are to protect <style="stress"><player_name></style>, for the sake of our investigation, I will serve as your personal guard for a time.

say:11:1010411007:0.text: Wait, wait, wait... What are you talking about?

say:12:1010411008:0.text: All of Lord Franz's invitations bear a single person's name, meaning only that person is invited to attend. Even as a member of the Mithril Consortium, I have no way of bringing a guest with me. Especially not an entire group of people!
say:12:1010411008:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨发出的所有邀请函都是实名制，一人一封。\n就算有...

say:13:1010411009:0.text: That crafty old man... Unfortunately, we don't have the time to forge invitations for everyone right now.
say:13:1010411009:0.source_cn: 那老家伙，还挺谨慎……但眼下这种情况，也来不及伪造出足...

say:15:1010411011:0.text:
What? Did you think that the Heroic Order was above using tricks like that?
However, like I said, we don't have the time.
say:15:1010411011:0.source_cn: 怎么，你以为骑士团一点手段都没有吗？\n不过就像我说的...

say:17:1010411012:0.text: I was thinking the same thing.
say:17:1010411012:0.male: I was thinking the same thing.
say:17:1010411012:0.female: I was thinking the same thing.

say:18:1010411015:0.text: Then let us go together. If anything should happen, I could provide some cover.
say:18:1010411015:0.source_cn: 那我和你们一起去，万一出了什么意外，可以帮你们打掩护。

say:19:1010411016:0.text: I won't say no to any help you can provide but don't expect us to pay you back or anything.
say:19:1010411016:0.source_cn: 小少爷，我不会拒绝送上门的帮助，到时候可别说我们利用你。

say:20:1010411017:0.text: How could I? I just want to help. Besides, this isn't enough to repay you for what you've done for me.
say:20:1010411017:0.source_cn: 怎么会呢？我很想帮上各位，这甚至不足以当做我对各位的报答。

say:21:1010411018:0.text: He sure knows how to butter people up.
say:21:1010411018:0.male: He sure knows how to butter people up.
say:21:1010411018:0.female: He sure knows how to butter people up.

say:22:1010411019:0.text: Now that we've decided on a plan. Let's start getting ready.
say:22:1010411019:0.source_cn: 既然决定了，便各自着手准备吧。

say:23:1010411020:0.text: Once we're ready, we'll leave immediately.
say:23:1010411020:0.source_cn: 做好准备后，我们就出发。

say:25:1010411013:0.text:
Just because you have magic doesn't mean you can go around breaking into people's houses.
I'm willing to overlook certain things for the sake of our investigation, but don't forget that Lord Franz has his own team of guards.
say:25:1010411013:0.source_cn: 你不要以为会用魔法，就可以直闯私人庄园！\n我虽然可以...
say:25:1010411013:0.male:
Just because you have magic doesn't mean you can go around breaking into people's houses.
I'm willing to overlook certain things for the sake of our investigation, but don't forget that Lord Franz has his own team of guards.
say:25:1010411013:0.female:
Just because you have magic doesn't mean you can go around breaking into people's houses.
I'm willing to overlook certain things for the sake of our investigation, but don't forget that Lord Franz has his own team of guards.

say:26:1010411014:0.text: Still, with so many people attending the banquet, we might be able to <style="highlight">sneak in</style> somehow.
say:26:1010411014:0.source_cn: 不过宴会期间，来来往往的人也很多，也许可以试着<sty...
say:26:1010411014:0.male: Still, with so many people attending the banquet, we might be able to <style="highlight">sneak in</style> somehow.
say:26:1010411014:0.female: Still, with so many people attending the banquet, we might be able to <style="highlight">sneak in</style> somehow.

choice:16:1:2.text: Let's break down the front door!
choice:16:1:2.male: Let's break down the front door!
choice:16:1:2.female: Let's break down the front door!

say:0:1010412001:0.text: That cart looks familiar... Wait, I saw it in Southville before!
say:0:1010412001:0.source_cn: 那辆货车好眼熟……我在南村的葡萄田附近见过！咱们上前看看吧！
say:0:1010412001:0.male: That cart looks familiar... Wait, I saw it in Southville before!
say:0:1010412001:0.female: That cart looks familiar... Wait, I saw it in Southville before!

say:0:1010413001:0.text: An empty cart meant for hauling grapes but no grapes...
say:0:1010413001:0.source_cn: 看起来是运送葡萄的车，可是一颗葡萄都没看见。难道是被谁吃了？
say:0:1010413001:0.male: An empty cart meant for hauling grapes but no grapes...
say:0:1010413001:0.female: An empty cart meant for hauling grapes but no grapes...

say:2:1010413501:0.text: I apologize for my tardiness! Is everyone alright? That gruglin just now looked especially tough...
say:2:1010413501:0.source_cn: 各位，我来晚了！你们没事吧\n刚才那只咕布林看上去很难...

say:3:1010413502:0.text:
It definitely gave us a challenge...
I'm happy to see you again, Miss. Did you finish your investigation?
say:3:1010413502:0.source_cn: 不是一般难对付……\n魔法师小姐，很高兴再次见到你，你...

say:4:1010413503:0.text: Yes... And I wanted to share my findings with everyone as soon as possible.
say:4:1010413503:0.source_cn: 是的……我取得了一些进展，想要赶快告诉你们。

say:5:1010413504:0.text: Judging from your expression, things must be even worse than we thought...
say:5:1010413504:0.source_cn: 看你的表情，情况似乎比想象中更严峻？

say:6:1010413505:0.text: I wanted to research Gemvine grapes to explain the differing flows of magic in the north and south of Ryeham. However, I uncovered the secret of the grapes themselves...
say:6:1010413505:0.source_cn: 我本想通过研究藤水晶，破解金穗村南北为何会有迥然不同的...

say:7:1010413506:0.text: I'm sure you know, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that these grapes confuse one's mind. They also affect Hypofiends.
say:7:1010413506:0.male: I'm sure you know, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that these grapes confuse one's mind. They also affect Hypofiends.
say:7:1010413506:0.female: I'm sure you know, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that these grapes confuse one's mind. They also affect Hypofiends.

say:8:1010413507:0.text: I can personally attest to that... But why?
say:8:1010413507:0.source_cn: 对此我深有体会……这是为什么呢？

say:9:1010413508:0.text: Because Gemvine grapes are anything but ordinary. They may look like fruit, but they've been heavily augmented by magic!
say:9:1010413508:0.source_cn: 因为藤水晶不是普通的葡萄，与其说它是水果，倒不如说，它...

say:10:1010413509:0.text: Every single grape contains powerful Hypogean magic, which attacks the mind as soon as it is consumed.
say:10:1010413509:0.source_cn: 果实里蕴藏着浓郁的邪恶魔力。吃下藤水晶后，高浓度的魔力...

say:11:1010413510:0.text: If my analysis is correct, then with a little refining, these grapes can be used to control other people's minds!
say:11:1010413510:0.source_cn: 如果我的分析没错……将这些果实加以精粹……甚至能制成操...

say:12:1010413511:0.text: And because they're grapes, they can still be used to make things like juice and tarts, making them even harder to detect.
say:12:1010413511:0.source_cn: 因为原材料是葡萄，所以很容易伪造成葡萄汁或葡萄挞之类的...

say:15:1010413512:0.text: Could all of this have something to do with the <style="highlight">dark mages</style>?

say:16:1010413513:0.text: Dark mages... I've heard of them before. A group of lawless fanatics who study forbidden magic.
say:16:1010413513:0.source_cn: 黑魔法师……我听说过，那是一群执着于禁术研究的疯子。

say:17:1010413514:0.text: But Lord Franz doesn't look like he can use magic at all.
say:17:1010413514:0.source_cn: 可那个弗朗茨，怎么看都不像是会用魔法。

say:20:1010413515:0.text: It's possible that Lord Franz is working with the dark mages.
say:20:1010413515:0.source_cn: 说不定，黑魔法师是弗朗茨葡萄事业的重要合伙人。

say:21:1010413516:0.text: We need to hurry! Lord Franz is most likely going to target the nobles attending his banquet!
say:21:1010413516:0.source_cn: 我们得加快脚步了，谁知道弗朗茨会不会用这些大礼招待宴会...

say:22:1010413517:0.text: We'll be in even more trouble if he manages to take control of them.
say:22:1010413517:0.source_cn: 如果贵族都任他操纵，事情就更麻烦了。

say:0:1010415101:0.text: This gruglin is huge! What's it doing in the middle of the road?!
say:0:1010415101:0.source_cn: 这只咕布林好大！它怎么堵在道路中间啊？！

say:1:1010415102:0.text: If we let it wander around, the general is going to have my pay reduced. Let's take care of this thing.
say:1:1010415102:0.source_cn: 要是放任它四处晃荡，我这个月的薪金可要泡汤了。把它解决掉吧。
